camel_example: aliyun ens TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'i-50000' --Tag.1.Key team --Tag.1.Value Deep --ResourceType instance
description_en: Creates and adds tags to specific Edge Node Service (ENS) resources
description_zh: 调用TagResources为指定的ENS资源列表统一创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun ens tag-resources --tag Value=Deep Key=team --resource-id i-50000 --resource-type instance --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

fields.help_en: The key of tag N that is added to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value cannot be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签键。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of tag N that is added to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs: or contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag that is bound to the instance
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can add up to 50 resource IDs in a call
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表。一次调用最多支持添加50个资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource. Set the value to instance
parameters.name: resource_type
